actions.name: Search
actions.description: Finds the pages and databases you shared with Fabric whose titles hold the words given, most recently edited first, 100 a page. Without words it lists them all. kind page finds pages only, and data_source databases only.

query.description: Words the titles hold, in any case.

kind.description: page finds pages only; data_source finds databases only.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Read page
actions.description: Reads one page you shared: its title, link and parent, its properties as plain text, and its content as Notion markdown, cut at 200,000 characters (markdownTruncated). truncated says Notion left parts out of the markdown; an <unknown> tag marks each.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

actions.name: Describe database
actions.description: Reads one database you shared and up to 5 of its data sources: each property's name, id and type, whether an agent may write it (and why not), and the options of select, status and multi-select properties. Find rows, Add database row and Update database row take these names.

database.description: The database: a Notion link or a database id.

actions.name: Find rows
actions.description: Finds the rows of one data source, 25 a page, in Notion's order, each with its title and values as plain text. match all reads every row. match where reads the rows its where values match, by property name: text, link, email and phone values as contains, each item of a multi-select, people or relation list as contains, and the other types as equals.

dataSource.description: The data source: an id from Describe database.

match.description: all reads every row; where reads only the rows the where values match, and needs where.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Create page
actions.description: Creates a page under a page you shared, with a title and, if given, its text as Notion markdown. A long title is split at Notion's limits, never cut.

parent.description: The page to create it under: a Notion link or a page id.

content.description: The page's text, as Notion markdown.

actions.name: Add database row
actions.description: Adds one row to a data source, with values keyed by property name as Describe database lists them. A value that does not fit the data source's properties as they are now is refused before anything is sent.

dataSource.description: The data source: an id from Describe database.

actions.name: Rename page
actions.description: Renames a page or a database row you shared. It sends only the new title, split at Notion's limits, never cut. The card shows the title now and the new one.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

actions.name: Update database row
actions.description: Changes values of one database row, keyed by property name as Describe database lists them; the others stay. A multi-select, people or relation value replaces the whole list, so give the full new list. Rows only: rename a plain page with Rename page.

page.description: The row: a Notion link or its page id, as Find rows gives it.

actions.name: Add to page
actions.description: Adds text at the end of one page you shared, as Notion markdown, and reads the page back to see it there.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

content.description: The text to add at the end, as Notion markdown.

actions.name: Edit page text
actions.description: Replaces one piece of text that occurs exactly once on a page you shared, or removes it when replace is empty. When the text is not found exactly once, nothing changes. It never deletes a child page or database.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

find.description: Text that occurs exactly once on the page, as its markdown reads.

replace.description: What replaces it; empty removes it.

actions.name: Move page
actions.description: Moves a page you shared under another page you shared. Only ordinary pages move: a database row, or a page inside another block, is refused.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

to.description: The page to move it under: a Notion link or a page id.

actions.name: Move to trash
actions.description: Moves a page or database row you shared to Notion's trash. Notion keeps it there, and Restore brings it back: Fabric never erases it.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

expr.const: Notion keeps it in its trash; Restore brings it back.

actions.name: Restore
actions.description: Brings a page or database row back from Notion's trash. It sends only in_trash false.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

actions.name: Comment or reply
actions.description: Adds a comment to a page you shared, which starts a discussion, or replies in a discussion by its id from Read comments. Give exactly one of page and discussionId. Notion shows it as written by Fabric's integration.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

discussionId.description: The discussion to reply in, as Read comments gives it.

actions.name: Read comments
actions.description: Reads the open comments of one page you shared, oldest first, 25 a page: each comment's id, discussion, author, time and its text in up to 30 pieces, as Notion splits it. Notion leaves resolved discussions out.

page.description: The page: a Notion link or a page id.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Find person
actions.description: Finds the people and bots of the workspace whose name is the name given, in any case, reading at most 10 pages of 100. It returns their ids, which people values take.

name.description: The person's name as Notion shows it.
